# M80 normalized restore input composer candidate

This root-authored additive composer produces local typed preparation-v3 input from actual bound observations. It does not call a database or provider, grant a stage gate, or execute migration. It is an unaccepted candidate.

The composer retains actual signed-in owner provenance and exact runtime/UI acceptance pins. It requires the recovered schema21 deployment identity, six successful current PR6 checks, current source and membership observations, and a separately reviewed normalized-upgrade publication manifest. That future publication receipt does not exist yet, so the current draft is not runnable with accepted actual inputs.

The new mapping reads the distinct v2 restore, normalization, preservation and migration receipts. Completion time, disposable database and backup receipt must agree. Raw application-state and metadata hashes remain separate from normalized metadata hashes. The preservation receipt must bind the exact normalization proof. Source content and state are linked to the actual backup; the accepted preparation-v3 validator must subsequently validate the full closed typed bodies and exact pins. No v1 raw metadata equality is fabricated.

New local output names use live002; durable migration/admission/deployment lock scope remains owned by the unchanged semantic operation scope in the preparation/once validators. Old live001 and consumed operation journals must not be deleted or reused. Partial local output cannot authorize execution and remains exclusive.

Independent source review and an actual consumer shape test are required before any real composition. The recovered-target stop/recovery/observer helpers are separate reviewed candidates. This report is not a publication, source-release or customer-readiness claim.
